title: Verify: PhaserHost single instance, cleanup, config and resize unit tests
summary: Unit tests with phaser and createGame mocked prove lifecycle, config and resize.
description: Write tests from REQ1 acceptance criteria. Phaser is mocked and no browser is used.
acceptance_criteria: Given StrictMode, When PhaserHost mounts, Then one live game and one destroy of the first.
Given resize, When the ResizeObserver mock fires, Then scale.refresh is called.

steps.action: vi.mock('../src/phaser/createGame') so createGame returns a fresh fake {destroy: vi.fn(), scale:{refresh: vi.fn()}} per call, recorded in an array. Stub global.ResizeObserver with a class that captures its callback and exposes disconnect. Add tests: (1) render <React.StrictMode><PhaserHost/></React.StrictMode>, assert the first fake destroy was called with true and the last fake was not destroyed; (2) render then unmount, assert destroy toHaveBeenCalledWith(true) once; (3) invoke the captured ResizeObserver callback, assert scale.refresh was called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx

steps.action: vi.mock('phaser', () => ({default:{AUTO:0, Scale:{FIT:3, CENTER_BOTH:1}, Game: class {}, Scene: class {}}})). Test buildGameConfig(document.createElement('div'), []) has render.pixelArt true, render.roundPixels true, scale.mode 3. Test computeZoom(1000,600,2) returns an integer >= 1 and computeZoom(10,10,1) returns 1.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts
